name: the_earlier_page
conceit: A current journal spread (the assumed order) is followed by an older leaf -- foxed, yellowed, deckled -- carrying an earlier record, then the book itself turns to show the corrected sequence. _03 (the page-turn) landed correctly illustrated; _02 (the older leaf on its own) drifted into looking like a photographed book prop rather than drawn art. The real fix per the architecture design is NOT a third independent generation: the 'earlier leaf' should be CODE-AGED from the SAME already-rendered current-page art (reusing panel_animator/elder_leaf.py's foxed-stock treatment) rather than a second independently-guessed generation trying to look older.

anti: a single-moment scene with no actual prior verse/type on record to reveal as 'earlier'
a beat that needs the two pages to visually MATCH exactly (registration) rather than merely read as the same book at two different ages -- see the_registration_pull's failure

plate_bill.must_contain: open handwritten journal page, aged cream paper, faint ruled lines, a small margin sketch of two stacked bundle icons suggesting an ordered list
a much older aged parchment leaf, foxed and yellowed, ink faded pale brown, held apart from a newer page, a small sketched lamb icon near the top, deckled edges, linen-tape corner repair
an open book spread seen from slightly above, one page caught mid-turn with real page thickness visible, warm raking light, a sketched lamb icon and a checklist icon on the pages

motion_slots.earned_by: the page-turn itself (P3, the clean still) is the one beat worth animating as real page-turn motion; do not animate P2 until it is rebuilt via the code-aging fix below rather than a second independent generation.

risk_flags: illustration_lock -- _02 drifted into a photographed-book-prop look; the fix is code-aging the CURRENT page's own art via panel_animator/elder_leaf.py's foxed-stock treatment, not a second independent generation guessing at 'older'

beat_template.hook: the current spread, the assumed order, a simple ordered list
beat_template.pivot: an older leaf surfaces, already recorded, dated before
beat_template.landing: the page turns, the sequence corrects itself

score_shape: a plain, present-tense reading pulse under the current page, dropping to something older and slower as the earlier leaf surfaces, resolving on a warm settled tone as the page physically turns.
